_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::lubrication#1. The rule (LUBRICATION elements are 2D surface elements) holds, but the Signal was fabricated: 4C has no 4C_lubrication_factory.cpp and never says 'unsupported element type for lubrication'. Rewriting element 1 of upstream lubrication_sb_2d.4C.yaml as a HEX8 aborts inside the generic mesh reader with "Element 'LUBRICATION' does not seem to know cell type 'hex8'." from core/fem/src/general/element/4C_fem_general_element_definition.cpp line 29 — before any lubrication code runs, so REACHED_TIME_LOOP=0. Both fabricated strings are asserted absent so the correction stays pinned. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: Element 'LUBRICATION' does not seem to know cell type 'hex8'.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave element 1 as the correct QUAD4 surface element. The abort and its cell-type diagnostic vanish, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from:
sed 's/1 LUBRICATION QUAD4 1 2 3 4 MAT 3/1 LUBRICATION HEX8 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 MAT 3/' \
    "$BASE" > "$TMP/hex8.yaml"
